meta.title: BSRP-ME Frameworks Alignment Matrix
meta.description: Cross-framework alignment of disaster risk reduction and development policies across global (Sendai), regional (FRDP), and national (NDRRP, NDP) levels for Fiji

frameworks.name: Sendai Framework for Disaster Risk Reduction
frameworks.description: Global framework adopted by UN member states to achieve substantial reduction of disaster risk and losses.

frameworks.name: Framework for Resilient Development in the Pacific
frameworks.authority: Pacific Community (SPC), SPREP, PIFS, UNDP, UNISDR, USP
frameworks.description: Regional voluntary framework providing high-level strategic guidance to Pacific Island countries on building resilience to climate change and disasters.

frameworks.name: National Disaster Risk Reduction Policy
frameworks.authority: Ministry of Disaster Management and Meteorological Services, Fiji
frameworks.description: Fiji's national policy to enable the country to prevent new and reduce existing disaster risk in line with Sendai Framework and FRDP.

frameworks.name: Fiji National Development Plan
frameworks.authority: Ministry of Finance, Strategic Planning, National Development and Statistics, Fiji
frameworks.description: Fiji's national development blueprint organized under three pillars: Economic Resilience, People Empowerment, and Good Governance, with Vision 2050.

alignmentThemes.title: Disaster Risk Understanding & Knowledge Management
alignmentThemes.description: Understanding disaster risk in all its dimensions, including data collection, risk assessment, hazard mapping, information sharing, research, and building knowledge capacity.

alignments.goalTitle: Strengthened Integrated Adaptation and Risk Reduction

elements.text: Improve knowledge, information, attitudes and practices on DRR. Leverage traditional wisdom (Fijian bures), DRR education, community volunteering, tree-planting campaigns, DRR White Paper.

items: Climate change modelling and hazard mapping for all urban centres
Improved national capacity for strategic foresight

alignmentThemes.title: Disaster Risk Governance & Mainstreaming
alignmentThemes.description: Strengthening disaster risk governance through legal frameworks, institutional arrangements, coordination mechanisms, and mainstreaming DRR into development planning across all sectors.

alignments.priorityTitle: Strengthening disaster risk governance to manage disaster risk

alignments.goalTitle: Strengthened Integrated Adaptation and Risk Reduction

items: (j) Link planning to public financial management
Review NDMA to incorporate DRR, climate change, gender, disability
Clear demarcation of DRR responsibilities national/local
Joint mainstreaming of DRR and CCA
National and local DRR action plans and SOPs
Good governance principles: transparency, effectiveness, equity, rule of law
National govt as primary duty bearer
Local govts key roles in land use, infrastructure, building codes
Strengthening rule of law and justice
NDMO developing joint CC/DRR action plan

alignmentThemes.title: Financing & Investment in Disaster Risk Reduction
alignmentThemes.description: Public and private investment in DRR through structural and non-structural measures, disaster risk financing, insurance mechanisms, and resource allocation for resilience building.

alignments.priorityTitle: Investing in disaster risk reduction for resilience

goalTitles: Strengthened Integrated Adaptation and Risk Reduction

items: Proactive investment in DRR within annual budgets
Social agreement on cost-sharing for disaster risks
Net Fiscal Deficit target: 2.5% of GDP
Disaster Risk Financing Policy with innovative solutions
$9.3 billion estimated needed over 10 years for climate resilience

alignmentThemes.title: Disaster Preparedness
alignmentThemes.description: Strengthening preparedness through contingency planning, capacity building, stockpiling, evacuation planning, and multi-hazard early warning systems.

alignments.priorityTitle: Enhancing disaster preparedness for effective response and to 'Build Back Better'

keyItems: (l) Relocation of facilities outside risk zones

alignments.goalTitle: Strengthened Disaster Preparedness, Response and Recovery

items: Structural measures: flood embankments, retention dams, drainage, mangroves, sea walls, evacuation centres
Non-structural: DRR education, risk assessment, building codes, hazard monitoring, business continuity plans
Continuous public awareness through 'no regrets' strategies
Increase national capability for risk foresight and early detection
Stricter compliance to building codes and standards

alignmentThemes.title: Emergency Response
alignmentThemes.description: Coordinated humanitarian emergency response, including relief operations, cluster coordination, rescue services, and emergency communication systems.

alignments.priorityTitle: Enhancing disaster preparedness for effective response

keyItems: (f) Train workforce and volunteers in response
(g) Regional protocols for sharing response capacities

alignments.goalTitle: Strengthened Disaster Preparedness, Response and Recovery

items: (g) Humanitarian coordination and emergency operations centres
Disaster Risk Information System (DRIS): collection, analysis, dissemination, management
SOPs with rescue-and-relief principles and timelines
Fiji Cluster System for humanitarian response coordination
Protection Code of Conduct for Humanitarian Workers
Setting up of National Disaster Management Office (NDMO)
Joint action plan for climate change and DRR

alignmentThemes.title: Recovery, Reconstruction & Build Back Better
alignmentThemes.description: Post-disaster recovery and reconstruction that reduces future risk, applying Build Back Better principles, livelihood restoration, and psychosocial support.

alignments.priorityTitle: ...and to 'Build Back Better' in recovery, rehabilitation and reconstruction

keyItems: (o) Psychosocial support and mental health services
(d) International Recovery Platform for experience sharing

alignments.goalTitle: Strengthened Disaster Preparedness, Response and Recovery

items: (e) Low carbon development and BBB approaches in recovery
Livelihood support to disaster victims during recovery
Streamlined Fiji Cluster System for recovery
National reconstruction plans based on PDNA/DLDA
Build Back Better (BBB) as goal for infrastructure/housing/facilities
Public emergency broadcasting for information dissemination
Build back better principles in post-disaster recovery
Recovery focus after TC Winston ($2 billion economic impact)

alignmentThemes.title: Climate Change Adaptation & Low-Carbon Development
alignmentThemes.description: Addressing climate change as a driver of disaster risk through adaptation measures, emissions reduction, renewable energy, ecosystem conservation, and alignment with the Paris Agreement.

alignments.priorityTitle: Investing in disaster risk reduction for resilience

elements.text: Sendai recognizes climate change as a driver of disaster risk (Preamble para 13)

items: Strategic objective: manage present/future risk within development planning
(i) Conserve forests, coasts, oceans for carbon stocks
Outcome: improved energy security, decreased net emissions

alignments.strategyTitle: Mainstreaming Disaster Risk Reduction (with CCA integration)

items: Joint mainstreaming of DRR and CCA
Climate change and disaster risk interlinked throughout the policy
Paris Agreement mandate respected alongside DRR measures
30% GHG reduction by 2030, net zero by 2050
100% renewable energy in electricity generation target
Operationalise Warsaw International Mechanism for Loss and Damage

alignmentThemes.title: Inclusion, Human Rights & Social Protection
alignmentThemes.description: Ensuring DRR and development efforts are inclusive of vulnerable groups (women, children, persons with disabilities, elderly, poor), protect human rights, promote gender equality, and provide social safety nets.

guidingPrinciples: (c) Protect human rights including right to development

keyItems: (k) Include people with chronic diseases in policies

items: (f) Gender analysis and human rights-based approaches

guidingPrincipleTitles: Human Rights and Gender Based Approaches

items: Broad popular participation of vulnerable groups
Protection against gender-based violence in emergencies
Children, youth, persons with disabilities, older persons in decision-making
Economic/social safety nets across all DRR phases

focusAreas: Protection of Children, Youth and People with Disabilities

items: Social protection: Family Assistance, Social Pension (26,200 elderly), Bus Fare Concession
Women participation in board directorship: 50% target
Fiji ranked 107/146 on WEF Gender Gap Index 2022

alignmentThemes.title: Multi-Hazard Early Warning Systems
alignmentThemes.description: Development and strengthening of multi-hazard early warning systems, hazard monitoring, forecasting, telecommunications infrastructure, and dissemination of timely warnings to all communities.

elements.text: Substantially increase availability of and access to multi-hazard early warning systems and disaster risk information to people by 2030

items: (j) Strengthen meteorological/hydrological/seismological services for hazard info and EWS
(h) Effective multi-hazard EWS for sudden/slow onset hazards
(i) Accessible warning language and messages for all groups
(c) Regional multi-hazard early warning mechanisms (Global Framework for Climate Services)
Tsunami Siren Networks and Evacuation Drills (Item 69)
Storm Surge Prediction and Coastal Inundation Prediction (Item 77)
Strengthen multi-hazard warning system with people-centred approach
Climate change modelling and hazard mapping
National capability for risk foresight and early detection

alignmentThemes.title: Resilient Infrastructure & Critical Facilities
alignmentThemes.description: Building and retrofitting infrastructure and critical facilities (schools, hospitals, transport, utilities) to withstand hazards, enforcing building codes, and ensuring service continuity.

elements.text: Substantially reduce disaster damage to critical infrastructure and disruption of basic services by 2030

items: (c) Resilience of critical infrastructure (water, transport, telecom, education, health)
(n) Enforce building codes and infrastructure design on critical facilities
(a) Minimise hazard risks in energy infrastructure
(d) Energy efficiency codes for public buildings

elements.text: Preparedness structural measures: flood control embankments, retention dams, drainage networks, mangrove planting, sea walls, safer schools and hospitals, evacuation centres
Build Back Better for infrastructure, houses and production facilities

items: 500 km new sealed roads in rural areas
88% total population access to clean water
Upgrade and maintain: roads, ports, wharves, rural airstrips, jetties, bridges
Enforce stricter compliance to building codes and standards

keyFunctions: Establishes guiding principles for all States
Translates global frameworks to regional context
Supports capacity building and resource mobilisation
Aligns with Sendai, SDGs, Paris Agreement
Allocates resources and assigns implementing agencies
NDP provides broader development context; NDRRP provides DRR-specific operationalisation
